bio: Richard A. Bennett (born May 24, 1963) is an American businessman and politician from the state of Maine. Initially elected as a Republican, he currently serves in the Maine Senate as an independent. He ran for Governor of Maine in the 2026 election, finishing third behind Republican nominee Robert B. Charles and the victor, Democratic nominee Hannah Pingree.
offices: Member of the State Senate of Maine (1996–present)
Member of the Maine House of Representatives (1990–1994)
